Hi Tom / Karen — looping in a short checklist and clarifying questions so we can scope evidence.

Priority (minimal) evidence we generally ask for when HIPAA + SOC 2 are in scope:
- Signed BAA (or confirmation you will sign ours) — required before any PHI exchange.
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months) or interim control evidence (if you don't have a report yet).
- Network diagram (high-level, show ingress/egress to Redwood endpoints).
- IAM / access control summary for integrations (who can access API keys, rotation policy).
- Data flow that illustrates where PHI lives, retention window, and deletion process.

Clarifying questions:
1) Who at MedSync will own returning the prefill and collecting internal docs? (security, integrations, or legal?)
2) For API payloads, do you have a staging endpoint with representative data we can test against after BAA is signed?
3) Any special encryption or HSM requirements for keys at rest?

Timeline and effort: if MedSync completes the prefill within 5 business days and provides the network diagram, our security team can produce a pre-assessment within 5 business days after that. Full SIG + evidence collection typically takes 3–4 weeks depending on availability of attestation owners. For pilot gating (early May), that timeline is tight but doable if we start this week.

I attached a sample network diagram template (redwood-network-diagram.pdf) and our fill guidance in the prefill.

Thanks — happy to do a 20-minute triage call tomorrow at 11am PT to walk through the template.

Marissa Cole
